# Vendored source provenance

omanix vendors part of Omarchy as a **committed, hand-fork snapshot** (decision D1 in
`PORTING-QUATTRO.md`). The upstream source is copied into this repo, committed to git, and
owned by omanix — there is **no** live dependency, **no** `flake = false` source input, and
**no** build-time fetch or patch. Reproducibility comes from git, not a lockfile. "Pinned"
means this file records the exact upstream rev and the files live in git.

To re-sync a newer upstream, re-run `scripts/vendor-omarchy.sh <rev>` and review the diff.

### Assets

All assets the shell references are **self-contained inside the `shell/` subtree** — no
external files needed to be gathered. This includes `plugins/emojis/emojis.json`, the agent
SVGs under `plugins/agents/assets/`, per-plugin helper scripts
(`plugins/clipboard/capture.sh`, `plugins/image-picker/list.sh`, `services/hidden-entries.sh`),
and all `manifest.json` / `qmldir` files. In-tree assets resolve via `$OMANIX_PATH/shell/…`
(the tree itself). After the Q0-03 rewrite, the shell also reads three **Nix-generated** files
at `$OMANIX_PATH/shell/config/shell.json` and `$OMANIX_PATH/shell/defaults/{omanix-menu.jsonc,
launcher.hides}` — these are **not** part of this vendored snapshot; Phase-1 packaging installs
them into `$out/shell/`.

### Flake input

No omarchy source flake input existed in `flake.nix` / `flake.lock` at vendor time — an
earlier draft plan that pinned a `flake = false` `omarchy-src` input was never implemented,
so there was nothing to remove. (Quickshell remains a normal packaged dependency, tracked
under Q1-01, and is unaffected.)

### Local-edit policy

omanix owns this copy, so **hand-edits to the vendored tree are allowed**. Keep them small
and **log each edit below** (path + one-line reason + date) so a future re-vendor knows what
to re-apply. If local edits ever grow large, promote them to a `vendor/patches/` set; until
then, this log is the record.
